Stage bypasses and20ps ideal controls are diagnostic only. Nonmonotonic tau/time-margin results are acknowledged; no unique internal failure mechanism or universal architecture impossibility is claimed.

Pair-voltage screen is separated from body PN forward bias, DC precision, model domain and reliability. NMOS/PMOS forward-bias signs match device junction polarity; no unqualified product candidate or A/B/C winner is declared.

Static I-V replay, normalized magnitude fit, synthetic C/tau response, transistor simulation and physical optical measurement remain separate. Same-pixel/temperature/deembedding/complex-data/large-signal gaps remain open.
